diagram_math_checks.result: By def-temperley-lieb-link-state-standard-modules, n=4, p=2 means t=0 and four ordered bottom sites with two arcs and no defects. The left panel has coordinates 0,1,2,3 labeled 1,2,3,4; arcs join 0 to 1 and 2 to 3, exactly (12)(34). The right panel has coordinates 5,6,7,8 labeled 1,2,3,4; arcs join 5 to 8 and 6 to 7, exactly (14)(23). All eight drawn endpoints are incident to exactly one arc.

Standalone original-resolution final tile 01 shows both disjoint adjacent arcs for x and an outer arc enclosing the inner arc for y. Neither panel has a crossing; all arcs reach their endpoint dots. Labels 1–4 and both matching labels are readable and separated. These are half-diagrams, so no closed polygon edge is asserted or required.

Using reflection and capping from lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-form-is-invariant and the closed-component scalar in def-temperley-lieb-diagram-category, self-gluing either matching gives two components (one for each doubled pair). Mixed gluing has the single alternating cycle 1-x-2-y-3-x-4-y-1. Thus diagonal values are delta^2 and off-diagonal values delta; at q=exp(pi i/3), delta=q+q^{-1}=1, producing the all-ones matrix of verification step 1.1.

The form is complex bilinear, so the all-ones Gram matrix has kernel a+b=0, namely C(x-y), as in step 2.1. No conjugate-linear convention is introduced by the figure. t=0 and kappa=3 give 3 not dividing t+1=1, matching the noncritical definition and step 3.1. The source quantum-integer recurrence gives [1]=[2]=1 and [3]=0, consistent with the stated determinant.
